title: Phi-Renormalization and Axisymmetric-with-Swirl Navier-Stokes: Algebraic Cancellation of the Axis Singularity
desc: We prove that in axisymmetric-with-swirl flow, the 1/r^4 axis singularity in the swirl-vorticity equation cancels exactly and algebraically upon substitution Phi = u_theta/r. The forcing (1/r^4) * partial_z(Gamma^2) reduces to partial_z((Phi^epsilon + Phi) * delta_Phi), requiring only the geometric identity Gamma = r^2 * Phi and no Hardy inequalities.
